sentences.en: He doesn't have a particle of kindness in his heart.
sentences.zh: 他心中一点善意也没有。

sentences.en: He does not have a particle of honesty in him.
sentences.zh: 他身上丝毫没有诚实可言。

sentences.en: Minute particles are hard to see with the naked eye.
sentences.zh: 肉眼很难看到这些微小颗粒。

senses.zh: 微粒；极少量；粒子（原子的极微小成分，如电子、质子或中子）；（数）质点；（语法中的）小品词，虚词
